court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Judicial Magistrate Court No.VII, Coimbatore, C.C.No.303 of 2005
facts_of_case: Selvakumari alleged bigamy by Aruchamy, who got married to Amudhavalli @ Valliammal after driving Selvakumari away from home. She filed a private complaint under Section 494 IPC. The trial court convicted the accused.

legal_principles.principle: The revisional court is not open to exercise the revisional power as a second appellate forum.
legal_principles.held: It is not open to this Court to exercise the revisional power as a second appellate forum.
cited_cases: State of Maharashtra Vs. Jagmohan Singh Kuldip Singh Anand and Others, (2004)7 SCC 659

legal_principles.principle: The revisional court is empowered to exercise all the powers conferred on the appellate court.
legal_principles.held: Section 401 CrPC confers power on the High Court or Sessions Court, as the case may be, “for the purpose of satisfying itself or himself as to the correctness, legality or propriety of any finding, sentence or order, recorded or passed, and as to the regularity of any proceedings of such inferior court”.
cited_cases: State of Maharashtra Vs. Jagmohan Singh Kuldip Singh Anand and Others, (2004)7 SCC 659

outcome.final_order: The judgment and order dated 10.02.2012 passed in C.C.No.303 of 2005 was set aside.

keywords: IV Additional District and Sessions Court
